summary: Verification and voice pass over the authoring form's 50 UI keys T376 shipped. Re-measured: 865 flattened keys per locale (not T376's 842 - the files grew since), key sets identical across es/en/fr, zero empty values, every key the form references resolves, no content string and no swatch-name string anywhere in the 50. acceptance.criterion: Read the three locales against each other, not just against the key list; voice warm and personal, sentence case, per the DS content fundamentals.
acceptance.evidence: 15 values changed across 10 keys - see the per-change list in this report's deviations-free changelog below (summary field + git diff of public/i18n/*.json). Highlights: goodToKnow.empty (es) mixed tu ('Anade') and vosotros ('escribais') in one sentence - now vosotros throughout, matching the couple-facing convention milestones established ('Cread vuestro primer hito'); note.good-to-know in all three locales dropped 'stored on the configuration' / 'se guarda en la configuracion' / 'enregistre dans la configuration' (API-speak, and wrong-preposition English) for 'shown exactly as written'; issue.faqTooFew harmonized digit '3' with its sibling's spelled-out 'one' in all three; fr dayLine.rsvpClosed's curly apostrophe normalized to the file's straight-apostrophe convention (140 straight vs 7 curly); fr dayLine.datesHint gained 'toutes seules' to carry the sentences-do-not-update-THEMSELVES point; fr dressCode.headline 'Titre' collided with field.title 'Titre du bloc' rendered directly above it - now 'Accroche' (es 'Titular' and en 'Headline' were already distinct); contacts.purpose es 'Para que escribirle' implied writing/messaging, which ADR-0014 bans and the guest side (tel: call button) contradicts - now 'Para que contactarle'; fr 'Pour quoi le contacter' (reads as a typo of 'Pourquoi') - now 'A quel sujet le contacter'. All strings sentence case; validation messages explain rather than scold (Save is withheld, the message says what is missing per block). Terminology checked against the guest half: section label, gift row labels (Concepto/Reference/Reference) and the three-language identifier hints all match what T375/T377 shipped.
